figures.claim: The angle between the two facets, the sulcus angle, is conventionally taught as about 138 degrees in a normal knee.

The articular cartilage of the trochlea is the thickest in the knee at the centre of the groove, reaching of the order of 5 mm, and the subchondral bone beneath the lateral facet is denser than beneath the medial, reflecting where load passes.
